observations: The page number «72» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02: the heading of chapter 25, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it; «59b», the b raised.

L07 and L16: the formulas displayed, centred, their fractions built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}, «·» the raised dot of multiplication; L07 ends «· r.», L16 with a full stop. L10: the formula «sin a = tg b / tg B» within the line, its fraction built up. a, b, c, A, B, C, δ, ε, r italic; sin, cos, tg, cot upright. L18: «60p», the p raised and italic.

A figure stands at the left of L13-L19, which are set in a narrower measure at its right; it is not reproduced. A right spherical triangle: B at the left, C at the lower right, A at the upper right; the arc c from B to A above, the arc a from B to C below, the arc b from A down to C on the right, the right angle at C. The letters are italic.

L03-L20. Checked: in the right spherical triangle with the right angle at C, the angle B the obliquity ε, the hypotenuse c the longitude, the side b the declination δ and the side a the right ascension, sin a = tan b cot B = tg δ · cot ε = sin δ cos ε : (cos δ sin ε), as printed.

L21-L32. Checked: with ε = 23° 51′, sin δ = sin 25° sin ε gives δ = 9° 50′ 21″, the value of Table 21 (L23), and tan a = cos ε tan 25° gives a = 23° 5′ 52″ (23° 5′ 51.7″), against Suter's 23° 5′ 50″ with five-place logarithms and 23° 5′ 49″ in Table 59; with Ptolemy's 23° 51′ 20″ it is 23° 5′ 48.5″. With al-Battānī's 23° 35′ it is 23° 8′ 24″, his 113° 8′ less 90°. The Table 59 values are to be compared with the table.

L34: after the hyphen of «Rect-» a thin vertical stroke, lighter than the print, of spacing material; L33: a small mark above the line before «0°»; not transcribed. N01: «Arin», «Azin», «Udjain» in italics.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Kh.», «Nallino»; italics: «Rectascension» (L03, L14; upright in L21, L27, L31, L33-L34), «secundum terram Arin», «Beispiel :», «Horoscopus arietis», the letters of the formulas.
The colons, the semicolons and the question mark stand after the thin space of the edition (10-18 px measured; «49″ ;» L26, 18 px).
